bestBets.overview: PEANUT BUTTER has been consistent without winning and will make presence felt as usual. PANCHO'S PLACE is firt up for new stable and must be respected in this company. VIVALDA mixes form but best is good enough. SHIMARI wasn;t beaten far latest and will only need to hold form to go close again. SPLENDIDA strips fiter for debut run and wouldn't shock in suitbale race. OUR ENCHANTRESS will be running on late as usual. SOVEREIGN CRUST looks the knockout hope at a price for new stable.

raceTips.comment:
Pretty open race to start the card. Going with PANCHO'S PLACE on top each way with little confidence. Maps to sit just of the pace and has been racing well in the metro area.
COONGAN KID has the option to lead and has done so at the trials. First race today with C. Parnham going on board.
COCOBELLE - I could be missing something here but her early work last campaign was pretty good. Goes around a wild price.
VIVALDA was good first up, not so second up. Lost a bit o trust there.

raceTips.comment:
Not a race that inspires confidene. Going with LORD ARCADIA on top with a little bit of hesitation. Will need a nice ride and also concious that he'll be better over further, but respectfully this is a weak field with other chances mapping poorly.
BATISTA comes back into maiden grade after a DQ - maps perfectly and could win again - but he hasnt gone on with it in Class 1 and 2 grade.
COBAR SKY is a horse who I wish had drawn a gate. Going better than the form guide.
Same with LOGIE - can improve but drawn a lemon again.

COULDABEENAHANDBAG is knocking on the door and must be rated highly. VIRESHA looks the knockout hope.

raceTips.comment:
TIGER TANK is really well placed here by Neville Parnham. Last two starts form jumps of the page. Third to Gods Cross and EightySeen Lad at Biunbury and then last start split Espresso Time and Marcos at Belmont. From the gate he should sit over the pace and be hard to hold out.
FEINDISH gets the services of Tash Faithful and consistently gets caught out of its ground. B2 and senior on board, look for a more positive ride. Big odds for Tash at Kal.
MORF is consistent but will have company up top today.
GOLD LILLY comes out of maiden grade and steps up in the weight and has drawn terribly. Pike on to weave his magic.

raceTips.comment:
Nearly now or never for this ghostly grey in ALOTTA FIGHTING. He has had genuine excuses at most starts this campaign - he was wide throughout last start and took off early to make sure he wouldnt leave his run late. Enter a 10/10 from Joey on board SIMPLY ROYALTY who probably was stiff to not win the Ride of the Week category. Got him on the line. Using that form line.
MORIAH is a backmarker with potential here second up after a nice first up effort.
KUTENAI goes around short.

raceTips.comment:
May be wanting to look to the swoopers by this part of the day if the rain comes. IDEALLY fits that bill. Drawn wide, can handle the rain and drops back from the 2100m back to a 1600m, all good box ticks.
ROYAL GUARDIAN was racing well prior to going to town and being eased down. Beat home half this field and meats them all better at the weights (The Candy Kid = 8.5kg!). Has had 6 weeks off. Trust in Fernie that she is right.
I NEVER DREAMED is racing well and can sit just over the leading brigade here, had no luck last start, won two back and sat 3 wide to be beaten 1 length 3 back. She is flying.
GIBRALTAR GOLD will start short for a horse with Pads going on.

raceTips.comment:
DEBONNAIRE was a hard watch first up. The map looks much better IF (BIG IF) if he can hold the back of our only leader in the race in SCIENCE DEGREE. That galloper will take him a long way into the race and Austin should be able to swing wide on straightening. 
SCIENCE DEGREE should lead unopposed here and is racing well.
RAINLINE won the Kambalda Cup, gets a bit of weight off and Tash in the saddle - do they try and find the 3 wide line?
TACITO is racing well but drawn very wide. Will need a good cart into the race and if they dont go hard out in front could be hard to work into it.

bestBets.overview: GINGER BAKER hit the line well latest and will appreciate the rise in trip here. ARCADIA KNIGHT resumes and wouldn't shock fresh. CITINO mixes form but best is good enough. LILLIAN won well 2 back and then was good again latest, keep safe. OPPORTUNISTIC fresh must be rated highly.

raceTips.comment:
LILLIAN looks well placed here for the Grantham/Peters combination and while she might be the second of the pair (Pike goes on board OPPORTUNISTIC) - she is fourth up, has the fitness edge and by this time of day could be in the right part of the track. Get the feeling she didnt enjoy the seven day backip last start when still running well. Has her customary 3 weeks between runs (3:3) and should be storming over the top of them. 
OUTSPOKEN LAD beat her home last time they met and he should have a bunny out in front with MONTY ZOOMER engaged.
OPPORTUNISTIC will improve of this outing (Kal Cup?) and GINGER BACKER was scratched out of yesterday's meet to line up here. Good edition.

bestBets.overview: LAVISH CHARM is a consistent type who will make presence felt as usual. STYLIN' did enough fresh to suggest she will be more than competitive here 2nd up. RIPPER RUPERT will find this easier than past couple and can improve sharply. SPANGLEDSTAR won well 2 back and then was good again latest, keep safe. VOMO ISLAND gets a soft run from the good gate and will be in this a long way. DANCEWITHME will get back from the wide gate but will be running on storng late.

raceTips.comment:
Tough get out stakes here - but we are getting some value.
SPANGLEDSTAR is absolutely airborne this season - she's a get back mare who wont have any issues with a chopped up deck come Race 8. Has had 9 starts in Kal this season for a record of 9:4,4,1 -  each way every day and we get close to $10. Yes please.
STYLIN' was 77 days in between runs and held down third. Improves of that effort and you get the combination you want to see.
THE LIONS GATE ran with SPANGLEDSTAR two starts back and then went around in tougher grade. Back to his grade here.
DANCEWITHME may get a long way off them but if they pack up she is racing well and will be the widest.
